true, responsive_web_grok_community_note_auto_translation_is_enabled: true, responsive_web_enhance_cards_enabled: false }; const url = '/i/api/graphql/oIetCo19avgStX4mOnGsPg/ListMembers?variables=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(variables)) + '&features=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(features)); const resp = await fetch(url, { headers, credentials: 'include' }); if (!resp.ok) return { error: 'HTTP ' + resp.status + ' ' + resp.statusText }; const data = await resp.json(); const instructions = data?.data?.list?.members_timeline?.timeline?.instructions || []; const results = []; const seen = new Set(); for (const inst of instructions) { if (!inst.entries) continue; for (const entry of inst.entries) { const user = entry?.content?.itemContent?.user_results?.result; if (!user) continue; const id = user?.rest_id || user?.id; if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue; seen.add(id); const legacy = user?.legacy || {}; const core = user?.core || {}; results.push({ id: String(id), break; } } return { results }; }
